title: FDG PET SUVR and PETPVE12 partial-volume correction using OpenNeuro ds002898
description: Audited quality-controlled single-subject FDG PET workflow using OpenNeuro ds002898, including motion correction, SPM12/PETPVE12 processing, cerebellar-cortex SUVR, regional summaries, and 4/5/6/8 mm PSF sensitivity analysis with explicit robustness checks.
notes: Audited portfolio release. The predefined primary-gray set contains 84 ROIs, with 81 retained in the post hoc QA robustness subset based on GM-support >=20 voxels. Robust cerebellar-normalized PVC-SUVR PSF CV is 1.437% median and 6.037% maximum; robust pre-normalization PVC-activity PSF CV is 3.029% median and 8.587% maximum. PSF-specific cerebellar normalization is explicitly separated from regional PVC sensitivity. This is a single healthy-young-adult research demonstration and is not intended for clinical or diagnostic use. Raw OpenNeuro data and intermediate imaging derivatives are not included.
